");
  background-position:center,center top;
  background-size:cover,100% auto;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral::before,
.bf17-scene--glass-only::before{display:none !important}
.bf17-scene .bf17-glass,
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{
  position:absolute;
  top:0 !important;
  right:0 !important;
  bottom:0 !important;
  left:0 !important;
  transform:none !important;
  height:100% !important;
  width:100% !important;
  max-width:none !important;
  padding:clamp(12px,1.65vw,25px) !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(234,249,255,.78);
  border-radius:inherit;
  overflow:hidden;
  box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(6,68,147,.16);
  backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px);
  background:linear-gradient(120deg,rgba(204,239,255,.21),rgba(228,246,255,.13));
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-glass{
  backdrop-filter:none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(9,49,138,.26) 0%,rgba(8,67,148,.08) 42%,rgba(214,238,253,.22) 55%,rgba(213,235,252,.88) 80%,rgba(218,240,255,.95) 100%);
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-scene-heading{
  position:absolute;
  left:clamp(14px,2.25vw,35px);
  right:clamp(14px,2vw,32px);
  top:clamp(13px,2.8dvh,26px);
  z-index:1;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-scene-heading h1{font-size:clamp(23px,2.8vw,39px)}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new{
  position:absolute;
  left:clamp(16px,2.5vw,36px);
  right:clamp(16px,2.5vw,36px);
  bottom:clamp(14px,2dvh,22px);
  width:auto;
  height:auto;
  min-height:0;
  max-height:36%;
  display:flex;
  align-items:stretch;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:0;
  padding:0 clamp(2px,.6vw,8px);
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new>p{
  font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,20px);
  color:#123b6a;
  line-height:1.44;
  padding-right:clamp(18px,2.6vw,33px);
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-next{
  bottom:0;
  right:0;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only{
  background:transparent !important;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(234,248,255,.19),rgba(206,235,251,.25));
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{
  flex:1;
  height:100%;
  min-height:0;
  gap:clamp(9px,1.7dvh,19px);
  justify-content:stretch;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene h2{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,36px);
  line-height:1.12;
  margin:0;
  padding:clamp(2px,.6dvh,9px) 0;
  color:#fff;
  text-shadow:0 2px 7px rgba(11,82,158,.32);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{
  min-height:0;
  flex:1;
  gap:clamp(9px,1.3vw,18px);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{
  min-width:0;
  min-height:0;
  height:100%;
  padding:clamp(8px,1vw,15px);
  gap:clamp(7px,1.1dvh,13px);
  border:1px solid rgba(242,250,255,.82);
  border-radius:clamp(13px,1.5vw,19px);
  background:rgba(232,244,255,.52);
  box-shadow:0 2px 9px rgba(6,70,128,.09);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-label{
  line-height:1.17;
  color:#173d70;
  font-size:clamp(13px,1.45vw,20px);
  font-weight:800;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice img{
  flex:1;
  height:0;
  min-height:0;
  width:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center center;
  border-radius:clamp(8px,1vw,12px);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-dialogue-new{
  flex:1;
  max-width:790px;
  width:100%;
  margin:0 auto;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:clamp(13px,2dvh,23px);
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-current{
  font-size:clamp(16px,1.9vw,25px);
  line-height:1.45;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-dialogue-new .bf17-unmapped{
  font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,16px);
  line-height:1.5;
}
/* Interfaz legible sin scroll a resolución reducida o zoom 125%. */
@media(max-height:675px){
  .bf17-scene .bf17-glass,.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{padding:9px 12px !important}
  .bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new{max-height:41%;bottom:10px}
  .bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new>p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.18vw,16px)}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{gap:7px}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene h2{font-size:clamp(19px,2.05vw,27px)}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{padding:6px;gap:5px}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-label{font-size:clamp(12px,1.23vw,16px)}
}
@media(max-width:780px){
  .bf17-scene .bf17-glass,.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf17-glass{padding:8px !important}
  .bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new{max-height:42%;left:13px;right:13px}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{gap:7px}
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{padding:5px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{animation:none}
}
/* V21 · refinamientos después de comprobar el encuadre real en Chromium. */
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new{
  top:63%;
  bottom:2%;
  height:35% !important;
  max-height:none !important;
  justify-content:center;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{
  justify-content:center;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{
  flex:0 1 auto;
  align-items:center;
  margin:auto 0;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice{
  height:auto;
  justify-content:center;
}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice img{
  height:auto;
  flex:0 1 auto;
  aspect-ratio:480/222;
  object-fit:cover;
}
/* La composición de título + tarjetas también permanece centrada; sin hueco intermedio. */
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-scene{justify-content:center !important;gap:clamp(12px,1.6dvh,19px)}
.bf17-scene--glass-only .bf19-choice-grid{margin:0 !important;flex:0 0 auto;align-items:center}

/* V23 — PRIMERA PANTALLA: mismo Glass real y de medidas fijas que el selector.
   No hay banda inferior celeste opaca, segunda tarjeta ni cambio en el escenario.
   La ilustración electoral se concentra arriba y se desvanece suavemente antes del diálogo. */
.bf17-scene--electoral {
  background:transparent !important;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral::after {
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0 0 25% 0;
  z-index:0;
  pointer-events:none;
  background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,71,154,.16),rgba(18,89,171,.02) 64%,rgba(25,108,197,.08)),url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  background-size:cover,cover;
  background-position:center top;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 0%,#000 66%,transparent 100%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 0%,#000 66%,transparent 100%);
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-glass {
  /* Reutiliza el material del Glass de «Elige cómo contarlo». */
  background:linear-gradient(130deg,rgba(234,248,255,.19),rgba(206,235,251,.25)) !important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(9px) !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px) !important;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new>p {
  color:#123b6a;
  text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(236,249,255,.48);
}
/* La escena ilustrada sigue nítida; SOLO la región del texto es vidrio esmerilado.
   El filtro no debe desenfocar los candidatos ni el título. */
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-glass{
  backdrop-filter:none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:none !important;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-glass::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:55% 0 0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(219,243,255,.08),rgba(214,240,255,.27));
  backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(7px);
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0%,#000 30%);
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0%,#000 30%);
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:0;
}
.bf17-scene--electoral .bf17-dialogue-new{z-index:1}

/* BLOCK FACE V24 — reemplazo únicamente de las escenas del capítulo; diagnóstico y menú intactos. */
.bf24-screen{--bf24-navy:#061c50;--bf24-panel:#051a4d;--bf24-border:#14baff;color:#f5fbff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100dvh;height:100dvh;background:#031d55;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Trebuchet MS','Arial Rounded MT Bold',system-ui,sans-serif}
.bf24-news{height:clamp(54px,8.8dvh,84px);flex:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#082c73,#05184a);border-bottom:3px solid #0742a7;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(12px,1.15vw,21px);padding:0 clamp(12px,1.35vw,22px);box-shadow:0 3px 11px #0015409c;min-width:0}
.bf24-news-label{font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(11px,1.13vw,18px);padding:clamp(9px,.87vw,15px);border:2px solid #0adfff;background:#0066d7;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #0062cb,0 0 11px #005aff8c;flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;clip-path:polygon(7px 0,calc(100% - 7px) 0,100% 7px,100% calc(100% - 7px),calc(100% - 7px) 100%,7px 100%,0 calc(100% - 7px),0 7px)}
.bf24-headlines{overflow:hidden;min-width:0;flex:1;white-space:nowrap;mask-image:linear-gradient(to right,transparent,#000 22px,#000 calc(100% - 15px),transparent)}
.bf24-news-track{width:max-content;display:flex;animation:bf17-ticker 54s linear infinite}
.bf24-headline-group{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,1.9vw,36px);padding-right:clamp(16px,1.9vw,36px)}
.bf24-headline{font-size:clamp(10px,.85vw,14px);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(16px,1.9vw,36px)}
.bf24-headline::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:2px;height:17px;background:#278edb}
.bf24-news:hover .bf24-news-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.bf24-metrics{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(9px,1.2vw,23px);flex:none;font-size:clamp(13px,1vw,18px);font-weight:900}
.bf24-metrics .bf24-metric{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.bf24-metrics .bf24-metric-icon{width:clamp(20px,1.65vw,31px);height:clamp(20px,1.65vw,31px);display:inline-flex;color:#fa4c91}
.bf24-metrics .bf24-metric-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%;stroke-width:2.7}
.bf24-metrics .bf24-divider{height:27px;width:1px;background:#127bd5}
.bf24-layout{width:100%;max-width:1850px;margin:0 auto;padding:clamp(13px,1.8dvh,22px) clamp(11px,1.2vw,25px);flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2.08fr) minmax(250px,1fr);gap:clamp(12px,1.25vw,24px)}
.bf24-main,.bf24-guide{min-width:0;min-height:0;border:2px solid #12afff;border-radius:16px;background:#041a4e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #063c92;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.bf24-main{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bf24-hero-image{flex:1;min-height:0;width:100%;background-image:var(--bf24-hero);background-position:center;background-size:100% 100%;background-repeat:no-repeat;image-rendering:auto}
.bf24-intro-text{flex:0 0 auto;margin:0 14px 13px;padding:clamp(14px,1.5vw,23px) clamp(15px,1.7vw,28px);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#082969,#07265f);border:2px solid #18b7ff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #06438e;border-radius:13px;min-height:110px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.bf24-intro-text p{flex:1;margin:0;font-size:clamp(12px,1.12vw,19px);line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.005em;color:#dcecff}
.bf24-next{flex:none;width:clamp(42px,4.5vw,66px);height:clamp(42px,4.5vw,66px);border:3px solid #13d3ff;background:#0485f3;color:white;border-radius:9px;font-size:clamp(24px,2.3vw,36px);font-weight:1000;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #1068cb;display:grid;place-items:center}
.bf24-next:hover,.bf24-next:focus-visible{filter:brightness(1.19);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.bf24-team-scene{height:100%;position:relative;background-image:var(--bf24-team);background-size:100% 100%;background-position:center;}
.bf24-team-hotspot{position:absolute;top:40.8%;height:55%;width:41.7%;background:transparent;border:0;outline-offset:-5px;border-radius:14px;transition:box-shadow .17s ease,background .17s ease}
.bf24-team-hotspot.red{left:8.7%}.bf24-team-hotspot.celeste{left:53%}
.bf24-team-hotspot:hover,.bf24-team-hotspot:focus-visible{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #ffe369,0 0 19px #ffe369cc;background:#fff1a41b}
.bf24-guide{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bf24-guide-header{height:70px;flex:none;border-bottom:2px solid #11adfc;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#072a6c,#041c4c);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 clamp(13px,1.5vw,26px);gap:13px;font-size:clamp(18px,1.5vw,27px);font-weight:900}
.bf24-guide-header .bf24-lamp{font-size:26px;color:#ffca25}
.bf24-guide-min{margin-left:auto;border:2px solid #05c0fa;background:#0876e7;width:35px;height:35px;border-radius:8px;color:white;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:23px;line-height:1}
.bf24-guide-body{overflow:auto;flex:1;padding:clamp(13px,1vw,20px)}
.bf24-guide-body:empty{background:transparent}
.bf24-guide-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:8px 0 22px}
.bf24-avatar{height:clamp(62px,6.5vw,112px);width:clamp(62px,6.5vw,112px);border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--avatar-ring,#ff5a83);object-fit:cover;flex:none;background:#143478}
.bf24-guide-bubble{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,18px);line-height:1.48;background:#e2efff;color:#142750;border-radius:12px;padding:clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px);position:relative;flex:1}
.bf24-guide-bubble::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-12px;top:38%;border-width:8px 12px 8px 0;border-style:solid;border-color:transparent #e2efff transparent transparent}
.bf24-technique{color:#fb3b69;font-weight:900}
.bf24-case{border:1px solid #078cf1;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#081e54;margin-top:10px}
.bf24-case-title{padding:12px 15px;border-bottom:2px solid #086fcd;font-size:clamp(14px,1.25vw,20px);font-weight:900}
.bf24-case-title span{font-size:22px;margin-right:7px}
.bf24-case-copy{padding:clamp(13px,1.4vw,23px);font-size:clamp(12px,1.05vw,18px);line-height:1.6;color:#e1eaff;margin:0}
.bf24-case-more{display:inline-block;margin:0 clamp(13px,1.4vw,23px) 18px;color:#a8ddff;text-decoration:underline;font-size:13px}
.bf24-rumor-screen{flex:1;min-height:0;padding:clamp(20px,2.5vw,47px);background:#041a4f;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(19px,3.1dvh,32px)}
.bf24-prompt{text-align:center;max-width:940px;margin:0 auto;color:#f4f8ff;font-size:clamp(18px,1.65vw,28px);line-height:1.36;font-weight:650}
.bf24-prompt strong{display:block;color:#19d4ff;font-weight:950;margin-top:8px}
.bf24-options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:clamp(13px,2vw,26px);align-items:stretch}
.bf24-option{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;gap:16px;min-width:0;min-height:clamp(235px,35dvh,340px);width:100%;padding:clamp(17px,2.2vw,32px);border:3px solid #fa5a83;background:#fde6ec;color:#141d47;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 0 12px #f02e6a4a;transition:transform .15s,box-shadow .15s;cursor:pointer}
.bf24-option.b{background:#d6f3ff;border-color:#19bfff;box-shadow:0 0 12px #03abed44}
.bf24-option:hover,.bf24-option:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #ffde7e,0 9px 25px #001b46aa}
.bf24-option-title{font-size:clamp(18px,1.9vw,30px);font-weight:950;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.bf24-option-letter{width:clamp(40px,3.3vw,54px);height:clamp(40px,3.3vw,54px);border:3px solid #a70c3f;background:#ef1859;color:white;clip-path:polygon(12px 0,88% 0,100% 12px,100% 88%,88% 100%,12px 100%,0 88%,0 12px);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.bf24-option.b .bf24-option-letter{border-color:#073f94;background:#076ade}
.bf24-option-quote{font-size:clamp(17px,1.6vw,26px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.38}
.bf24-result{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,65px);text-align:center;background:#041a4f}
.bf24-result .bf24-spark{font-size:clamp(28px,3.5vw,60px);font-weight:1000;color:#ffd65c;margin:0}
.bf24-result .bf24-impact{max-width:850px;font-size:clamp(20px,2.1vw,37px);line-height:1.43;margin:0;color:#e5f1ff;font-weight:650}
.bf24-result .bf24-foot{font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,18px);color:#6fd1ff;margin:0}
.bf24-ticker-flash .bf24-headline{color:#fff4ca}
@media(max-width:850px){.bf24-screen{overflow:auto;min-height:100dvh;height:auto}.bf24-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:12px}.bf24-main{min-height:440px;aspect-ratio:1.4}.bf24-guide{min-height:220px}.bf24-news{height:58px}.bf24-news-label{font-size:10px;padding:8px}.bf24-metrics{gap:8px}.bf24-metrics .bf24-metric-icon{width:18px;height:18px}.bf24-guide-header{height:52px}.bf24-option{min-height:220px}.bf24-rumor-screen{padding:20px}.bf24-guide-row{align-items:flex-start}}
@media(max-width:510px){.bf24-main{min-height:500px;aspect-ratio:auto}.bf24-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bf24-option{min-height:140px}.bf24-intro-text{margin:0 7px 7px;padding:10px;min-height:130px}.bf24-hero-image{min-height:250px}.bf24-team-scene{min-height:450px}.bf24-news{padding:3px}.bf24-news-label{font-size:9px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bf24-news-track{animation:none}.bf24-option{transition:none}}

/* V25: transición a titulares; una opción = un botón completo. */
.bf25-compact-result{gap:clamp(12px,2.2dvh,22px);padding:clamp(26px,3.5vw,54px)}
.bf25-compact-result .bf24-spark{font-size:clamp(24px,2.45vw,41px);line-height:1.22;max-width:830px}
.bf25-compact-result .bf24-impact{font-size:clamp(17px,1.65vw,25px);max-width:860px;line-height:1.45}
.bf25-compact-result .bf24-foot{font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,15px)}
.bf25-continue{align-self:flex-end;margin-top:auto}
.bf25-headlines-screen{flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(10px,1.7dvh,20px);background:#041a4f;padding:clamp(14px,2.1dvh,26px) clamp(16px,1.7vw,30px);overflow-y:auto}
.bf25-story-prompt{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(17px,1.65vw,27px);font-weight:750;line-height:1.38;color:#f0f7ff;max-width:960px;margin:0 auto}
.bf25-story-prompt strong{color:#14d9ff;font-weight:1000}
.bf25-original{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,16px);line-height:1.38;color:#afd0fc;margin:0 auto;max-width:880px}
.bf25-original span{font-size:clamp(10px,.85vw,13px);color:#ffd768;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.02em}
.bf25-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(10px,1.35vw,18px);flex:1;min-height:0;align-content:stretch}
.bf25-post{grid-column:span 2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;border:2px solid #15aaff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f4faff 0%,#dfecfc 100%);border-radius:11px;min-width:0;min-height:155px;padding:0;color:#0b2757;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #061b51;transition:border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s,transform .16s}
.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4){grid-column:span 3}
.bf25-post:hover,.bf25-post:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:#ffd55b;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #ffd55b77,0 6px 0 #061b51}
.bf25-post.selected{border-color:#7fe3ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #7fe3ff55,0 5px 17px #7fe3ff55}
.bf25-post-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:clamp(6px,.6vw,10px);background:#073273;color:#deedff;min-height:46px}
.bf25-number{width:clamp(30px,2.6vw,41px);height:clamp(30px,2.6vw,41px);background:#13a8f8;border:2px solid #37d4fa;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:6px;color:white;font-size:clamp(17px,1.3vw,22px);font-weight:1000;flex:none}
.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4) .bf25-number{background:#13a8f8;border-color:#37d4fa}
.bf25-post-origin{font-size:clamp(9px,.71vw,12px);font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.04em}
.bf25-post-text{padding:clamp(13px,1.05vw,20px);font-size:clamp(14px,1.15vw,20px);line-height:1.4;font-weight:800;display:block;flex:1;align-content:center}
.bf25-post-bottom{padding:6px clamp(12px,1vw,18px) 8px;margin:0 clamp(10px,.85vw,15px);border-top:1px solid #b3d0eb;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:clamp(10px,.72vw,12px);font-weight:750;color:#4372a5}
.bf25-select-mark{font-size:21px;font-weight:900;color:#0a8fe5;line-height:1}
.bf25-post.selected .bf25-select-mark{color:#fc2864}
.bf25-avatar-wrap{width:clamp(62px,6.5vw,112px);flex:none}.bf25-avatar-wrap .bf24-avatar{display:block}
@media(max-width:1050px){.bf25-headlines-screen{padding:18px}.bf25-grid{gap:9px}.bf25-post-text{font-size:14px}.bf25-story-prompt{font-size:19px}}
@media(max-width:850px){.bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.bf25-post,.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4){grid-column:span 1;min-height:180px}.bf25-headlines-screen{overflow:visible}.bf25-story-prompt{font-size:18px}}
@media(max-width:510px){.bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bf25-post,.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4){grid-column:span 1;min-height:130px}.bf25-post-text{padding:12px}.bf25-story-prompt{font-size:17px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bf25-post{transition:none}}

/* V26 — CUATRO publicaciones pixel art, sin cuenta, avatar ni contadores por tarjeta. */
.bf25-headlines-screen{
  background:#04194b; padding:clamp(10px,1.35dvh,18px) clamp(14px,1.25vw,23px);
  gap:clamp(9px,1.4dvh,14px);overflow-y:auto;
}
.bf25-original{
  order:0;width:100%;max-width:none;text-align:left;
  padding:clamp(8px,.85dvh,12px) clamp(13px,1vw,18px);
  background:#06286a;border:2px solid #12c7ff;border-radius:8px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #061342;color:#e9f4ff;
  font-size:clamp(12px,.9vw,15px);font-weight:650;
}
.bf25-original::before{content:'▶';display:inline-grid;place-items:center;margin-right:10px;
  color:#fff;background:#fc2865;padding:3px 7px;border:2px solid #ffc2d4;
  border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;vertical-align:baseline}
.bf25-original span{font-size:clamp(11px,.85vw,14px);color:#ffda58;font-weight:950}
.bf25-story-prompt{order:1;max-width:none;text-align:left;font-size:clamp(16px,1.28vw,22px);line-height:1.35;padding:0 8px;color:#f8faff}
.bf25-story-prompt strong{color:#f4faff;font-weight:850}
.bf25-story-prompt::before{content:'?';display:inline-grid;place-items:center;vertical-align:middle;
  width:32px;height:32px;margin-right:11px;color:#001b47;background:#24c9fc;
  border:2px solid #0c78aa;box-shadow:3px 3px #02102f;font-weight:1000;border-radius:3px;font-size:23px}
.bf25-grid{order:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));
  grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(184px,1fr));gap:clamp(12px,1.2vw,19px);
  flex:1;min-height:0;align-content:stretch}
.bf25-post,.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4){grid-column:span 1;min-height:0;display:flex;
  border:3px solid #14cdf8;border-radius:8px;background:#e7f2fe;
  color:#061947;box-shadow:0 4px #001438;overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .13s, box-shadow .13s,transform .13s;}
.bf25-post:hover,.bf25-post:focus-visible{outline:none;border-color:#ffce5d;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #ffce5d99,0 4px #03113e}
.bf25-post.selected{border-color:#7fe3ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #7fe3ff66,0 0 17px #5fd8ffa3;}
.bf25-post-top{min-height:clamp(41px,5.3dvh,53px);background:#092a67;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  padding:clamp(5px,.48vw,8px) clamp(9px,.7vw,13px);}
.bf25-number{width:clamp(28px,2.45vw,42px);height:clamp(28px,2.45vw,42px);
  border:3px solid #49deff;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:2px 2px #01205b;
  background:#079fe9;color:white;font-size:clamp(16px,1.28vw,23px);}
.bf25-post:nth-child(4) .bf25-number{background:#13a8f8;border-color:#37d4fa}
.bf26-menu{color:#e7f3ff;font-size:clamp(14px,1.1vw,22px);letter-spacing:2px;line-height:1}
.bf25-post-text{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(10px,1vw,17px) clamp(13px,1.2vw,22px);
  color:#071a46;font-size:clamp(15px,1.17vw,21px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.35;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f3f9ff,#e3efff);}
.bf25-post-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;
  margin:0 clamp(12px,1vw,18px);padding:clamp(5px,.5vw,8px) 1px;
  border-top:2px solid #b6d5f1;background:transparent;color:#0b2c5b;}
.bf26-social-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  width:clamp(19px,1.65vw,27px);height:clamp(19px,1.65vw,27px)}
.bf26-social-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.bf26-social-icon.bars svg{stroke-width:0;fill:currentColor}
@media(max-width:1000px){
 .bf25-headlines-screen{padding:10px;gap:9px}
 .bf25-story-prompt{font-size:clamp(14px,1.55vw,18px)}
 .bf25-post-text{font-size:clamp(13px,1.55vw,16px)}
 .bf25-grid{gap:10px;grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(166px,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
 .bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:none}
 .bf25-post,.bf25-post:nth-child(n+4){min-height:150px}
 .bf25-headlines-screen{overflow-y:auto}
 .bf25-original{font-size:12px}
 .bf25-story-prompt{font-size:16px}
}



/* V28: tipografía más pixel-art para las publicaciones */
.bf25-post-top,.bf25-number,.bf26-menu,.bf25-post-text,.bf25-original,.bf25-story-prompt,.bf24-guide-header,.bf24-guide-bubble,.bf24-case-title,.bf24-case-copy,.bf24-case-more{font-family:"Press Start 2P","VT323","Courier New",monospace;}
.bf25-post-text{letter-spacing:.01em;line-height:1.45;font-size:clamp(14px,1.08vw,18px);font-weight:700;}
.bf25-post-top{letter-spacing:.04em;}
.bf25-number{font-size:clamp(16px,1.2vw,21px);font-weight:900;}
.bf26-menu{font-family:"Press Start 2P","VT323","Courier New",monospace;letter-spacing:.15em;}
.bf25-original{font-size:clamp(12px,.92vw,15px);line-height:1.45;}
.bf25-story-prompt{font-size:clamp(20px,1.45vw,26px);line-height:1.35;}
.bf24-guide-bubble{font-size:clamp(13px,1vw,16px);line-height:1.55;}
.bf24-case-title{font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,15px);}
.bf24-case-copy,.bf24-case-more{font-size:clamp(11px,.86vw,14px);line-height:1.6;}


/* BLOCK FACE MVP — extensión del diseño V28, sin alterar imágenes ni pantallas existentes */
.bfmvp-story-continue{align-self:flex-end;min-height:44px;padding:10px 24px;flex:none;border:2px solid #83edff;background:#079af2;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #02133f;color:white;border-radius:5px;font:800 clamp(13px,1.05vw,18px) 'Courier New',monospace;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.03em}
.bfmvp-story-continue:hover,.bfmvp-story-continue:focus-visible{background:#0877ca;outline:2px solid #ffda58;outline-offset:2px}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bfmvp-story-continue{order:3;margin-left:auto;min-height:38px;padding:6px 20px;font-size:14px}
.bfmvp-story-result{width:100%;height:100%;overflow-y:auto;background:#061c50;color:#f5f8ff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(12px,2dvh,23px);padding:clamp(24px,5vw,65px)}
.bfmvp-story-label{margin:0;color:#ffd65a;letter-spacing:.12em;font:bold clamp(12px,1vw,15px) 'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-story-result h1{font:bold clamp(24px,3.25vw,49px)/1.2 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffd65a;margin:0}
.bfmvp-story-result>p:not(.bfmvp-story-label){font:600 clamp(16px,1.72vw,26px)/1.4 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;margin:0;max-width:920px}
.bfmvp-story-result .bfmvp-story-note{color:#e4f4ff;background:#0c3169;border-left:4px solid #0fcdff;padding:12px 16px}
.bfmvp-story-result .bfmvp-story-reminder{font-size:clamp(12px,.95vw,16px)!important;color:#aed4fa}
.bfmvp-story-result .bfmvp-story-continue{margin-top:clamp(6px,2vh,16px)}
.bfmvp-role-switch h1{color:#20d8ff}
.bfmvp-receiver{--bg:#03194d;--cyan:#16bdf9;--ink:#f3f8ff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100dvh;background:#03194d;color:#f5fbff;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;box-sizing:border-box;overflow:auto}
.bfmvp-receiver *{box-sizing:border-box}
.bfmvp-header{height:clamp(56px,9dvh,76px);flex:none;background:#06245a;border-bottom:3px solid #16bcf9;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(10px,2vw,28px);padding:10px clamp(15px,2vw,30px);font-size:clamp(11px,1.1vw,16px)}
.bfmvp-header strong{background:#087df4;padding:12px 16px;border:2px solid #31d4ff;border-radius:6px;box-shadow:3px 3px #011636;color:white}
.bfmvp-header span{color:#a8e7ff;font-weight:900}

.bfmvp-receiver-main{width:min(100%,1120px);margin:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:15px;padding:clamp(18px,3vw,35px)}
.bfmvp-exercise,.bfmvp-summary{width:100%;max-width:990px;background:#08255e;border:3px solid #13c7f4;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:4px 4px #010d2d;padding:clamp(18px,2.5vw,34px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(11px,1.65dvh,21px)}
.bfmvp-eyebrow{font:bold 13px 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffda65;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
.bfmvp-exercise h1,.bfmvp-summary h1{font:bold clamp(25px,3vw,43px)/1.18 'Courier New',monospace;margin:0;color:#f7f9ff;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.bfmvp-context,.bfmvp-summary>p{color:#bcd9ff;font-size:clamp(13px,1.3vw,17px);line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.bfmvp-publication{background:#edf6ff;color:#071b47;border:3px solid #30c8ff;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #00143b}
.bfmvp-pub-top{background:#0a337c;color:#edfaff;padding:10px 17px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:900;font-size:13px}
.bfmvp-pub-body{font:bold clamp(17px,2.2vw,25px)/1.35 'Trebuchet MS','Courier New',monospace;padding:clamp(15px,2vw,24px)}
.bfmvp-pub-icons{border-top:1px solid #c2d8f0;padding:5px 15px;color:#42618a;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:20px}
.bfmvp-evidence{font-size:clamp(13px,1.15vw,16px);line-height:1.5;padding:12px 14px;border-left:4px solid #27d8ff;background:#0c3470}
.bfmvp-instruction{font-size:clamp(16px,1.45vw,20px);font-weight:900;margin:3px 0}
.bfmvp-answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.bfmvp-answer{display:block;width:100%;border:2px solid #23bbf5;border-radius:7px;background:#0a3779;color:white;font:800 clamp(13px,1.1vw,17px) 'Courier New',monospace;text-align:left;padding:clamp(11px,1.4vw,17px);cursor:pointer}
.bfmvp-answer:hover,.bfmvp-answer:focus-visible{background:#0861a7;outline:2px solid #ffd86c;outline-offset:2px}
.bfmvp-answer.is-chosen{border-color:#ffcf60;background:#175488}
.bfmvp-answer:disabled{opacity:.85;cursor:default}
.bfmvp-feedback{padding:15px 17px;background:#0a3566;border:2px solid #3da9ec;border-radius:9px;font-size:clamp(13px,1.05vw,16px);line-height:1.5}
.bfmvp-feedback>strong{color:#ffd66c}.bfmvp-feedback p{margin:8px 0}.bfmvp-feedback button,.bfmvp-controls button{background:#058feb;color:white;border:2px solid #68d9ff;font:900 15px 'Courier New',monospace;border-radius:6px;padding:11px 19px;cursor:pointer;margin-top:7px}
.bfmvp-feedback button:hover,.bfmvp-controls button:hover{background:#0769b8}
.bfmvp-summary .bfmvp-scores{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:13px}
.bfmvp-scores>div{background:#0e3879;border:2px solid #2bcaff;padding:16px;border-radius:8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.bfmvp-scores strong{color:#ffda5a;font-size:clamp(24px,3vw,36px)}.bfmvp-scores span{font-size:14px}
.bfmvp-skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.bfmvp-skill{background:#0b3070;border-left:4px solid #18d0ff;padding:14px;display:grid;gap:3px}.bfmvp-skill>span{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,16px);font-weight:900}.bfmvp-skill strong{color:#ffdc6b;font-size:22px}.bfmvp-skill small{font-size:12px;color:#b9d2fa}
.bfmvp-disclaimer{font-size:12px!important;color:#c2d1e8!important}.bfmvp-positive{border:2px solid #32c8ff;background:#164577;padding:14px;line-height:1.5}
.bfmvp-controls{display:flex;gap:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}.bfmvp-storage-warning{padding:9px 13px;background:#63311b;border:1px solid #ffd66a;border-radius:7px;color:white;font-size:12px;margin:0}
@media(max-width:740px){.bfmvp-header span:nth-child(2){display:none}.bfmvp-answers,.bfmvp-skills{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfmvp-receiver-main{padding:12px}.bfmvp-story-result{padding:19px}.bf25-headlines-screen .bfmvp-story-continue{order:3}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bfmvp-story-continue,.bfmvp-answer{transition:none}}

/* V31 · continuidad visual: feed pixel art + guía + misiones, sin bloque de cuestionario */
.bfmvp-receiver { min-height:100dvh; height:100dvh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#061c50; color:#f3f7ff; font-family:'Courier New',monospace; overflow:hidden }
.bfmvp-receiver * {box-sizing:border-box}
.bfmvp-receiver-header{height:78px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;padding:7px 18px;background:#082657;border-bottom:3px solid #04bafe}
.bfmvp-receiver-header>strong{border:2px solid #24d7ff;border-radius:6px;background:#0480dd;padding:11px 15px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #02133f;white-space:nowrap;font:bold clamp(12px,1.05vw,18px) 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-receiver-ticker{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;flex:1;color:#ecf2ff;font:700 clamp(10px,0.93vw,15px) 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-receiver-ticker span{border-right:2px solid #1acbff;padding-right:30px}
.bfmvp-receiver-status{font:bold 11px 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffd45e;white-space:nowrap}
.bfmvp-receiver-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2.07fr) minmax(280px,0.98fr);gap:20px;padding:15px 17px;min-height:0;flex:1;max-width:1800px;width:100%;margin:0 auto}
.bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfmvp-guide{min-height:0;min-width:0;border:2px solid #04bbff;border-radius:16px;background:#081f53;overflow-y:auto;scrollbar-color:#188dd2 #051a44;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #010e30}
.bfmvp-guide{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bfmvp-guide-title{flex:none;border-bottom:2px solid #17b6f4;padding:18px 20px;font:bold 23px 'Courier New',monospace;color:#f7fbff}
.bfmvp-guide-inner{padding:20px;display:grid;align-content:start;gap:20px}
.bfmvp-guide-line{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px}
.bfmvp-guide-avatar{background:#06bbf0;border:3px solid #7eebff;border-radius:50%;width:56px;height:56px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;box-shadow:2px 3px #001136;color:#082253;font-size:30px}
.bfmvp-guide-line p{font:700 clamp(14px,1.14vw,18px)/1.45 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;margin:0;color:#e9f3ff}
.bfmvp-guide-result{background:#0d3677;padding:14px;border-left:4px solid #ffd25f;font:700 15px/1.4 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-guide-result>strong{color:#ffe175;display:block}.bfmvp-guide-result>span{display:block;font:700 16px 'Courier New',monospace;margin:6px 0}.bfmvp-guide-result p{margin:8px 0}
.bfmvp-case-box{border:2px solid #119ce6;border-radius:7px;padding:13px;background:#0d326b;line-height:1.42;font:14px 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-case-box>strong{font:bold 13px 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffe075}
.bfmvp-case-box p{margin:10px 0}.bfmvp-case-box a{color:#a9f4ff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.bfmvp-mission{padding:clamp(16px,2.2vw,31px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;min-height:100%}
.bfmvp-mission-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.bfmvp-pixel-eyebrow{font:bold clamp(10px,.87vw,13px) 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffcf67;letter-spacing:.1em}
.bfmvp-mission-top h1{margin:9px 0 0;color:#26d9ff;font:bold clamp(22px,2.4vw,36px)/1.1 'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-mission-dots{display:flex;gap:6px}.bfmvp-mission-dots i{display:block;width:12px;height:12px;border:2px solid #1577a9;background:#07163b;transform:rotate(0)}
.bfmvp-mission-dots i.done{background:#1be1c5;border-color:#8afaf2}.bfmvp-mission-dots i.current{background:#ffda60;border-color:#ffeab4}
.bfmvp-mission-stage{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(260px,.91fr);gap:19px;align-items:start}
.bfmvp-post-side{min-width:0}
.bfmvp-tweet{background:#eaf4ff;color:#0d1b49;border:3px solid #21c6f8;border-radius:7px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #011435}
.bfmvp-tweet-top{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:#0c3877;color:#f6faff;padding:9px 11px;font:bold 12px 'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-tweet-top strong{flex:1}.bfmvp-tweet-glyph{font-size:17px;color:#9cfcff}
.bfmvp-tweet-copy{font:900 clamp(16px,1.38vw,22px)/1.25 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;padding:17px 15px}
.bfmvp-tweet-actions{border-top:1px solid #b5cde6;padding:6px 15px;display:flex;gap:24px;font-size:18px;color:#3a567c}
.bfmvp-art{background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-size:400% 200%;background-repeat:no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated;background-color:#071b4b}
.bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{aspect-ratio:1.7/1;width:100%;border-top:2px solid #1d4e81}
.bfmvp-art-market{background-position:0% 0%}.bfmvp-art-files{background-position:33.333% 0%}.bfmvp-art-museum{background-position:66.666% 0%}.bfmvp-art-alarm{background-position:100% 0%}
.bfmvp-art-festival{background-position:0% 100%}.bfmvp-art-bots{background-position:33.333% 100%}.bfmvp-art-timer{background-position:66.666% 100%}.bfmvp-art-library{background-position:100% 100%}
.bfmvp-play-side{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.bfmvp-quest{color:#e4f4ff;font:bold clamp(16px,1.3vw,22px) 'Courier New',monospace;line-height:1.35;margin:2px 0}
.bfmvp-choice-group{display:grid;gap:10px}
.bfmvp-choice{width:100%;min-height:52px;text-align:left;background:#0a3b81;color:#fff;border:2px solid #16c2ff;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #04132a;border-radius:4px;padding:12px 13px;cursor:pointer;font:bold clamp(12px,1.1vw,16px)/1.25 'Courier New',monospace;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.bfmvp-choice span{color:#ffe286;font-size:17px}.bfmvp-choice:hover,.bfmvp-choice:focus-visible{background:#1362ac;outline:2px solid #ffda5f;outline-offset:1px}
.bfmvp-choice:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.78}.bfmvp-choice.is-chosen{border-color:#ffe26a;background:#17548d}
.bfmvp-inspect{align-self:flex-start;background:transparent;border:2px dashed #4ec7ff;color:#b0f7ff;padding:8px 11px;cursor:pointer;font:bold 12px 'Courier New',monospace}.bfmvp-inspect span{font-size:16px}
.bfmvp-inspect:hover{background:#124b82}.bfmvp-clue{padding:12px;border-left:4px solid #30ddff;background:#12376d;line-height:1.35;font:700 14px 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-clue[hidden]{display:none}
.bfmvp-after-answer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;color:#ffe27b;font:bold 13px 'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-after-answer button,.bfmvp-controls button{background:#078edf;color:white;border:2px solid #5eebff;border-radius:4px;padding:12px 13px;cursor:pointer;font:bold 12px 'Courier New',monospace;box-shadow:3px 3px #01112d}
.bfmvp-after-answer button:hover,.bfmvp-controls button:hover{background:#076abf}
.bfmvp-timer{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;background:#311f53;border:2px solid #fe639b;border-radius:3px;padding:8px;box-shadow:3px 3px #081234}
.bfmvp-timer span{font:bold 11px 'Courier New',monospace;color:#ffcfe3}.bfmvp-timer strong{color:#ff9cc1;font:bold 21px 'Courier New',monospace}.bfmvp-timer button{font:bold 10px 'Courier New',monospace;background:#402a74;color:white;border:1px solid #ff84a9;padding:7px;cursor:pointer}
.bfmvp-timer small{grid-column:1/-1;font:11px 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;color:#fff}
.bfmvp-timer small[hidden]{display:none}
.bfmvp-end{padding:clamp(20px,3vw,42px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.bfmvp-end-banner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:180px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:center}
.bfmvp-end-banner .bfmvp-art{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;border:3px solid #30dcff;border-radius:7px}
.bfmvp-end-banner h1{font:bold clamp(20px,2.5vw,36px)/1.2 'Courier New',monospace;color:#32ddff;margin:0 0 12px}
.bfmvp-end-banner p{font:700 clamp(15px,1.25vw,19px)/1.45 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;margin:0}
.bfmvp-end-main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px}
.bfmvp-end-main h2,.bfmvp-final-prompt strong{color:#ffe17b;font:bold 14px 'Courier New',monospace}.bfmvp-earned{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.bfmvp-skill-tag{color:#d8fbff;border:2px solid #2987dc;background:#0c3370;padding:8px;font:bold 12px 'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-end-note,.bfmvp-final-prompt p{color:#edf5ff;font:700 14px/1.4 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif}
.bfmvp-final-prompt{padding:15px;background:#0b3b7c;border-left:4px solid #2bdaff}
.bfmvp-details{font:13px/1.5 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;color:#c2d3ee}.bfmvp-details summary{cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;font-family:'Courier New',monospace}
.bfmvp-controls{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
/* Transición con ilustración y guía activo dentro del mismo mundo. */
.bfmvp-switch-scene{padding:clamp(22px,4vw,55px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,.7fr) minmax(0,1.4fr);align-items:center;gap:28px;height:100%;color:white}
.bfmvp-switch-art{aspect-ratio:1/1;width:100%;max-width:370px;border:3px solid #18ceff;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:5px 5px #010d2f}
.bfmvp-switch-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}.bfmvp-switch-copy h1{font:bold clamp(22px,2.7vw,42px)/1.2 'Courier New',monospace;color:#22d5ff;margin:0}
.bfmvp-switch-copy p:not(.bfmvp-story-label){font:700 clamp(16px,1.55vw,23px)/1.35 'Trebuchet MS',sans-serif;margin:0}
@media(max-width:1100px){.bfmvp-mission-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfmvp-tweet-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center}.bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{border-top:0;min-height:180px;aspect-ratio:1.4}.bfmvp-choice-group{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.bfmvp-receiver-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.6fr) minmax(260px,.85fr)}}
@media(max-width:780px){.bfmvp-receiver{height:auto;min-height:100dvh;overflow:auto}.bfmvp-receiver-layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.bfmvp-guide,.bfmvp-receiver-play{overflow:visible;width:100%}.bfmvp-guide{min-height:220px}.bfmvp-receiver-header{height:58px}.bfmvp-receiver-header strong{font-size:11px}.bfmvp-receiver-status{display:none}.bfmvp-receiver-ticker{display:none}.bfmvp-mission-stage,.bfmvp-tweet-body,.bfmvp-end-banner,.bfmvp-end-main{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfmvp-tweet .bfmvp-art{aspect-ratio:1.7/1}.bfmvp-choice-group{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfmvp-switch-scene{grid-template-columns:1fr}.bfmvp-switch-art{max-width:250px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.bfmvp-mission-dots i{transition:none}}

/* Retrato humano en pixel art. El rostro se suministra mediante el sistema visual V41. */
.bfmvp-guide-avatar{background:#082658;border:2px solid #67defa;border-radius:50%;width:57px;height:57px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:2px 3px #001136;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bfmvp-avatar-red{border-color:#ff92b0}


/* V32 · tokens.css */
/* V32 — única fuente de verdad para el lenguaje arcade de Friends. */
:root {
  --bf-bg:#061a49;--bf-surface:#092659;--bf-panel:#092453;--bf-raised:#103c7d;
  --bf-cyan:#20cdff;--bf-cyan-dark:#087fb5;--bf-yellow:#ffd45e;
  --bf-pink:#ff4c88;--bf-celeste:#27c9f3;--bf-white:#f4f8ff;
  --bf-muted:#c4d9f1;--bf-ink:#071b3d;--bf-danger:#ff7a91;--bf-success:#7be4ac;
  --bf-stroke:3px;--bf-step:4px;--bf-shadow:4px 4px 0 #010d2d;
  --bf-font-display:'Lucida Console','DejaVu Sans Mono','Courier New',monospace;
  --bf-font-body:'Lucida Console','DejaVu Sans Mono','Courier New',monospace;
}


/* V32 · base.css */
/* Mantener imágenes y escala de píxeles nítidas; no interrumpir la legibilidad de textos. */
html,body,#app{background:var(--bf-bg);color:var(--bf-white);font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
body{overflow-x:hidden}
body,button,input,select,textarea{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-variant-ligatures:none}
button{touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible,[tabindex]:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;outline-offset:3px!important}
img,canvas,.bfmvp-art,.bf24-hero-image,.bf24-team-scene{image-rendering:pixelated}
a{color:#9eefff}
::selection{background:var(--bf-yellow);color:var(--bf-ink)}
*{scrollbar-color:#1d91c5 var(--bf-bg)}
.bfpx-icon{display:inline-block;flex:none;vertical-align:middle;width:24px;height:24px;background-position:center;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated}
.bfpx-icon.small{width:18px;height:18px}
.bfpx-icon.large{width:30px;height:30px}
/* La generación inyecta imágenes raster PNG sin rutas remotas. */

.bfpx-icon.check{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAeUlEQVR4nO2VsQ2AMAwEA3NkLLahZhvGYg/oEAVWbCUyh/RXUsDpXgmliJ8xffXh9djPt+dztkgLnFDqZNZMW11uD1whnJA5mSevh+h7cIVwQq780ew9c+MK4YTCF6M1h0X0VOIK4YS6/mWjLs8nuEI4ISGEEEKIZC5xUB8p8rGaHwAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==')}

.bfpx-icon.news{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAfklEQVR4nO2XQQqAMBADu+IH/J4P9Hs+oZ6ERdDs0tbmkDl58DAkZKFWHMdZa5nAvpnd38sMgS8khJAQYo385FfQQmTFdAnRCYUq82SPZ7ZuuoQkhJAQIr2yXkfyDbqE6ISGHMaWWukSohPSyhB0QqHK/nyv0SVEJySEEOLBBVzaFK+ze8auAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC')}
.bfpx-icon.shield{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAfUlEQVR4nO3WwQnAMAwDQKdzdKxsk3e3yVjdo/k6D+MIGqqC7p2HkCC4GKjd/UHeX2ctyPsDi7MfXaCwTnQaVDQlXUN0gabads8U8fPRNaRAGQXK6GPM0AVaOg3emm/lFKFriC4QdM2Z6WL8HjyZF82HzuTRNUQXSERE5O8GSy4cKk3DtFYAAAAASUVORK5CYII=')}
.bfpx-icon.book{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAX0lEQVR4nO3WQQqAIBBAUQ2P05k6XGfqPraVKD6DECP8t1MY+biaUrSYOh76dfTQ8H7Wt/uZd7bI4B8MIgYRg4hBxCBiEDGIGEQMIumC2szwuMx/LfxR6X4oXZAk6eEGNGMMMjkCxVkAAAAASUVORK5CYII=')}
.bfpx-icon.spark{background-image:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAaUlEQVR4nO3XsQ3AIAwFUZt5MhPDZSb2IQsk+sSAcHGvpIATkoVwm9Bb7W/rft0e3bPEc/YgSCFIGZqGr2n6fdjA9KW7IYIUghRfNUGrpLshghSCFN4yhSCFICX8fzLjX3YGQUq6IAC7PcMGE2hGxeRYAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC')}
/* Título y microtexto arcade: monospace compacto, sin mezclas de sans web. */
.bfmvp-story-result h1,.bfmvp-switch-copy h1,.bfmvp-mission-top h1,.bfmvp-end-banner h1,
.bf24-guide-header,.bfmvp-guide-title,.bf24-news-label,.bfmvp-receiver-header>strong{
 font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;font-weight:900!important;letter-spacing:.005em;
 text-shadow:2px 3px 0 #041538;
}


/* V32 · components.css */
/* Marcos y controles pixelados, compartidos entre las dos identidades del jugador. */
.bf24-main,.bf24-guide,.bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfmvp-guide,.bfmvp-receiver-play,
.bfmvp-story-result,.diagnostic-shell,.diagnostic-intro-card,.welcome-card,.menu-dialog,
.identity-dialog,.bfmvp-tweet,.bf25-post,.bf24-option,.bfmvp-case-box{
 border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:var(--bf-shadow)!important;
}
.bf24-main,.bf24-guide,.bfmvp-receiver-play,.bfmvp-guide{background:var(--bf-panel)!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bf24-guide,.bfmvp-guide{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.bf24-guide-header,.bfmvp-guide-title{height:66px!important;min-height:66px;flex:none!important;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;
 background:#0b306a!important;border-bottom:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;padding:12px 19px!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;font-size:clamp(18px,1.55vw,23px)!important}
.bf24-lamp,.bfpx-guide-icon{font-size:0!important;display:inline-block;flex:none;width:24px;height:24px;background:url('data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAACQAAAAkCAYAAADhAJiYAAAAfElEQVR4nO3WUQ5AQBADUCOO40wO50zus34RTWetSfrR94lE0yZLTEA7tobu/SHWPd6uz5Uv/UIu0JJ5CNWLjMwt15BcoNRkSGaa3rnlGpILlJqs+pC8kmtILlDJwThCriEHYhyIcSDGgRgHYm7fqIo/wF5yDckFMjOzhxOfDBQ9vN19lQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==') center/contain no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated;color:transparent!important}
.bf24-guide-min{border-radius:0!important;width:29px!important;height:29px!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;box-shadow:2px 2px #01152d!important}
.bf24-guide-body,.bfmvp-guide-inner{background:transparent!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.bf24-guide-row,.bfmvp-guide-line{align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}
.bf24-guide-bubble,.bfmvp-guide-line p,.bfmvp-guide-result,.bfmvp-case-box,.bf24-case-copy{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.02vw,16px)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.bf24-guide-bubble,.bfmvp-guide-result{border-radius:0!important;background:#11366c!important;box-shadow:none!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;padding:13px!important}
.bf24-case,.bfmvp-case-box{background:#0b316a!important;border:2px solid #218ac7!important;border-radius:0!important;padding:14px!important}
.bf24-case-title,.bfmvp-case-box strong{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
.bf24-avatar,.bfmvp-guide-avatar{width:48px!important;height:48px!important;flex:none!important;border-radius:0!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #010b24!important;object-fit:cover}
.bfmvp-avatar-red{border-color:var(--bf-pink)!important}
.bfmvp-pixel-head{border-radius:0!important}
.bf24-news,.bfmvp-receiver-header{height:73px!important;min-height:73px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
 background:#09285f!important;background-image:none!important;border-bottom:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:8px clamp(12px,1.2vw,20px)!important}
.bf24-news-label,.bfmvp-receiver-header>strong{border:3px solid #78eaff!important;background:#0877c9!important;padding:12px 14px!important;white-space:nowrap;
 border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #010f31!important;color:#fff!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1.05vw,17px)!important}
.bf24-headlines,.bfmvp-receiver-ticker{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(11px,.87vw,13px)!important;letter-spacing:0;color:#e7f6ff!important}
.bf24-headline,.bfmvp-receiver-ticker span{font-family:inherit!important;font-weight:700!important}
.bf24-metrics,.bfmvp-header-metrics{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.bf24-metric,.bfmvp-header-metric{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,17px);color:var(--bf-white);font-weight:800}
.bf24-metric-icon{display:grid;place-items:center}
.bf24-metric-icon svg{image-rendering:pixelated;shape-rendering:crispEdges}
.bf24-divider,.bfmvp-metric-divider{height:28px;width:2px;background:#166aa1}
/* Cuadros sin esquinas redondeadas ni sombras difuminadas. */
.bf24-next,.bfmvp-story-continue,.bfmvp-after-answer button,.bfmvp-controls button,.bfmvp-choice,.bf24-option,.bf25-post,.bfmvp-inspect,
.bfmvp-timer button,.bf24-guide-min,.welcome-button,[data-action="start-diagnostic"],.menu-dialog button,
.onboarding-actions button,.diagnostic-footer button{
 border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #021332!important;transition:background .1s steps(2,end),transform .1s steps(2,end)!important;
}
.bfmvp-story-continue,.bfmvp-after-answer button,.bfmvp-controls button{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;background:#0a7ecb!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;
 border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;min-height:44px!important;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.bfmvp-story-continue:hover,.bfmvp-after-answer button:hover,.bfmvp-controls button:hover{background:#1256a4!important}
.bf24-next:hover,.bfmvp-story-continue:hover,.bfmvp-choice:hover,.bf25-post:hover{transform:translate(-1px,-1px)!important;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #021332!important}
.bfmvp-mission-dots i{border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan-dark)!important;width:14px!important;height:14px!important}
.bfmvp-mission-dots i.current{background:var(--bf-yellow)!important;border-color:#fff0aa!important}
.bfmvp-mission-dots i.done{background:var(--bf-success)!important;border-color:#b8fbd7!important}


/* V32 · chapter.css */
/* Escenas históricas: conservar las ilustraciones y los hotspots ya aprobados. */
.bf24-screen{background:var(--bf-bg)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.bf24-layout{gap:clamp(11px,1.3vw,20px)!important;padding:clamp(10px,1.4vw,17px)!important}
.bf24-news{background-image:none!important}
.bf24-main{overflow:hidden}
.bf24-hero-image{image-rendering:pixelated!important}
.bf24-intro-text{background:#0c326a!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.bf24-intro-text p{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1.15vw,18px)!important;font-weight:700!important;line-height:1.4!important}
.bf24-team-hotspot{border-radius:0!important}
.bf24-rumor-screen,.bf25-headlines-screen{background:var(--bf-panel)!important}
.bf24-prompt,.bf25-story-prompt{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-weight:750!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-size:clamp(15px,1.45vw,22px)!important}
.bf24-prompt strong,.bf25-story-prompt strong{color:var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bf24-option,.bf24-option.b{background:#0e3976!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #01102d!important;min-height:200px!important;padding:clamp(14px,2vw,26px)!important}
.bf24-option.a{border-color:var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bf24-option:hover,.bf24-option:focus-visible{background:#13508c!important;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bf24-option-title,.bf24-option-quote{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;line-height:1.4!important}
.bf24-option-letter{border-radius:0!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;background:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bf24-result,.bf25-compact-result{background:var(--bf-panel)!important}
.bf24-spark,.bf24-impact,.bf24-foot{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;line-height:1.42!important}
.bf24-spark{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bf25-original{border-left:4px solid var(--bf-yellow)!important;border-radius:0!important;color:var(--bf-muted)!important;background:#0c2e62!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;padding:10px 14px!important;text-align:left!important}
.bf25-original span{color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;font-weight:900}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:12px!important}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:nth-child(n){grid-column:auto!important;min-height:148px!important;background:#e5f2ff!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #01102e!important}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:hover,.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post:focus-visible{background:#f0f8ff!important;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;transform:translate(-1px,-1px)!important}
.bf25-headlines-screen .bf25-post.selected{background:#e3f3ff!important;border-color:var(--bf-yellow)!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #0b5a8c!important}
.bf25-post-top{background:#103c7d!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;padding:7px 12px!important}
.bf25-number{background:var(--bf-cyan)!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;border-radius:0!important}
.bf25-post-text{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-weight:800!important;font-size:clamp(13px,1vw,17px)!important;line-height:1.35!important;padding:11px 14px!important}
.bf25-post-bottom{border-top:2px solid #b8ccdf!important}
.bf24-case,.bf24-guide-bubble{border-radius:0!important}
.bfmvp-story-result{background:var(--bf-panel)!important;gap:18px!important;justify-content:center!important;min-height:100%;padding:clamp(20px,4vw,52px)!important}
.bfmvp-story-result h1{font-size:clamp(24px,2.7vw,42px)!important;color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.bfmvp-story-result>p:not(.bfmvp-story-label){font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-weight:700!important;font-size:clamp(14px,1.32vw,19px)!important;max-width:760px!important;line-height:1.45!important}
.bfmvp-story-note{background:#103669!important;border-left:4px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;padding:13px 16px!important}
.bfmvp-story-reminder{color:var(--bf-muted)!important}
.bfmvp-switch-scene{background:var(--bf-panel)!important;gap:clamp(16px,2.2vw,30px)!important;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,45px)!important}
.bfmvp-switch-art{border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 #01102e!important}
.bfmvp-switch-copy h1{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,38px)!important;color:var(--bf-cyan)!important}
.bfmvp-switch-copy p:not(.bfmvp-story-label){font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;font-size:clamp(14px,1.3vw,20px)!important;line-height:1.45!important;font-weight:700!important}
.bfmvp-switch-copy .bfmvp-story-continue{margin-top:8px}
/* Inicio, consentimiento, identidad y diagnóstico: no regresar a fichas web blancas. */
.menu-dialog,.identity-dialog,.diagnostic-shell,.diagnostic-intro-card,.welcome-card,.friends-story-card{background:#09285f!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:5px 5px 0 #010f2d!important}
.menu-dialog h2,.identity-dialog h2,.diagnostic-intro-card h1,.welcome-card h1,.progress-title{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important;color:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.menu-dialog p,.menu-dialog label,.identity-dialog p,.identity-dialog span,.welcome-card p,.diagnostic-intro-card p{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.diagnostic-screen,.diagnostic-intro-screen{background:#061a49!important}
.diagnostic-shell{overflow:hidden!important;max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px)!important}
.progress-indicator,.diagnostic-footer{background:#0b316a!important;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bf-cyan-dark)!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.progress-title,.progress-number,.diagnostic-body{color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.progress-track{border-radius:0!important;background:#153e7d!important}
.progress-fill{border-radius:0!important;background:var(--bf-yellow)!important}
.diagnostic-body{background:#0b316a!important}
.publication{background:#e7f3ff!important;color:var(--bf-ink)!important;padding:14px!important;border:3px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:3px 3px #02142e!important}
.publication *{color:var(--bf-ink)}
.publication-author{font-family:var(--bf-font-display)!important}
.source-avatar,.publication .source-avatar{border-radius:0!important}
.trust-fieldset legend{color:var(--bf-white)!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.trust-fieldset label{font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
.consent-checkbox{background:#0e3a74!important;color:var(--bf-white)!important;border:2px solid var(--bf-cyan)!important;border-radius:0!important}
.consent-copy,.identity-label,.identity-subtitle{color:var(--bf-white)!important}
.dialog-close,.identity-regenerate,.identity-confirm-row button,.onboarding-actions button,.welcome-button{border-radius:0!important;font-family:var(--bf-font-body)!important}
